title: Measuring reasoning capabilities of ChatGPT
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and quantifying "logical faults" (also referred to as "fallacies" in a general reasoning context) in LLMs when solving reasoning puzzles. The examples and classification of faults (e.g., inconsistencies, unsupported claims, bad arithmetic, lack of commonsense in specific factual scenarios) are strictly logical or factual reasoning errors, not moral or ethical judgments or religious evaluations. While the term "fallacies" can sometimes encompass informal or ethical fallacies, the paper's content and scope are exclusively limited to logical reasoning capabilities.
